as_told.title: Karl Wolfe shown photo of structures on far side of the Moon at Langley
as_told.place_text: Langley; far side of the Moon

plain: In the 1960s, a technician named Karl Wolfe is said to have been shown photographs of a huge city of giant stone structures on the far side of the Moon. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells it, relaying Wolfe's own account: while repairing a machine at a facility of the NSA, the US electronic spying agency, Wolfe was shown mosaic photographs, pieced together from Moon-mapping missions, showing "a huge megalithic city on the dark side of the moon." Jorjani adds that Ingo Swann, known for remote viewing, the claimed ability to see distant places with the mind, confirmed it. John Blitch, a scientist who worked for DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency, tells it too, also from Wolfe. In his version it happened at Langley, a Virginia base, and they were described as "huge structures" rather than a city. If true, it would mean someone built on the Moon before us and the government kept the pictures quiet.
